label: Monitor
name: monitor
description: A monitor of observed HTTP calls: the routes talk to a REST API (mockapi.io); entries are imported from and exported to CSV files through the blob registry. Plugins come from npm packages named by "from". No secrets: the API is public.

startup.label: Reach the entry store
startup.description: Read the entries once before the HTTP server opens, so a tree whose upstream is unreachable refuses to serve instead of answering every route with a fault. The port is bound per profile, so this checks whatever storage the profile chose.

startup.label: Watch for changes
startup.description: Serve the tree again whenever a document changes, without closing the port. A change that does not pass wilanis check is reported and the last good tree keeps answering.

startup.label: Listen
startup.description: Open the HTTP port and answer this tree's routes. Delete this step and nothing listens: a tree serves because it says so, never because a trigger exists.
